correctness.rationale: For finite noninteracting species with fixed immigration lambda_i>0, local loss mu_i>=0 and a common Poisson clearing clock gamma>0, stationary patch age is Exp(gamma) and the conditional occupancy solves a two-state ODE. Its two exponential Laplace moments yield L_ij=gamma*lambda_i*lambda_j/[(gamma+s_i)(gamma+s_j)(gamma+s_i+s_j)]. Diagonal scaling reduces L to the symmetric Cauchy matrix, so its minors, rank by distinct s_i and stated determinant follow from the exact Cauchy double alternant. Bernoulli variance normalization gives Pearson rho_ij as claimed and strict rho<1/2, sharp as gamma->0 in the identical zero-loss pair. Gamma derivative of log rho is strictly decreasing after multiplying by gamma if local loss is positive, giving exactly one positive cubic root; zero-loss case is strictly decreasing. Deterministic common recovery delay gives rho=1 outside model. Independently solved 48 exact-rational stationary four-state generators, matching marginals/covariances and half bound; finite checks are corroboration only.
